title: Sarbacher known to Australian nuclear engineers; Woomera
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Sarbacher known to Australian nuclear engineers; Woomera, about 1950s at Woomera test site, Australia, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Ross Coloulthart has some interesting data points around some of the nuclear engineers,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Ross Coulthart, a journalist, has found interesting information about some nuclear engineers in Australia who knew the scientist Robert Sarbacher. The story links to Woomera, a weapons testing site in Australia, in the 1950s. Michels presents it as a sign that Sarbacher's claims about secret UFO work were known about overseas.
